key_insight: Orchestrated LLMs can extract patient pathways and guideline rules directly from text, enabling conformance checking even when formal computer-interpretable guidelines are unavailable.
clinical_relevance: This could make guideline adherence auditing more feasible in routine hospital settings, especially in specialties where structured guideline formats are rare.
method: Extracted patient traces from discharge letters using multiple LLM components.
Identified normative statements from written clinical guidelines.
Translated rules into executable scripts and computed a Trace Conformance Indicator.
evidence_signal: In the stroke care evaluation at Alessandria Hospital, hundreds of patient traces were checked against 50 guideline-derived rules, and more than 86% of available traces were conformant.
watch_item: Results come from a single hospital/domain and depend on LLM orchestration quality, so generalizability and reliability in other settings need further validation.
paper_title: LLM-Orchestrated Conformance Checking in Stroke Care Without Computer-Interpretable Guidelines
